answer_reserve.formula: R = close(</think>) + J(longest legal final, canonical JSON) + W + EOS; thinking cap = 8192 - R
answer_reserve.status: 已决定（用户 2026-10-18「按你倾向」）：grammar_ws_w22。见 refine-logs/human54_unified_entry_20261018/USER_DECISIONS.md。
limitations: W=22 counts one whitespace run, after the root value. The backend grammar allows the same run ("" | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}; json-schema-to-grammar.cpp:228) after "[", after every array item and after every comma (:932 array rule; every item ends with space: string with minLength :945, pattern :534, enum :844). A 16-word CVLT array has 33 such positions; the canonical single space after each comma is inside J, the rest is not counted. Enumerations and the digit-recall string have one position, after the root value.
J is the token count of the canonical JSON text under the model tokenizer. Constrained sampling may split the same text into more tokens, so J is a lower bound on the generated final tokens.

Observed: the 4 prior native CVLT array finals (human13_format_repair runs, deepseek-r1:7b recall and follow-up, deepseek-r1:14b recall and follow-up) equal the canonical json.dumps text after stripping. A final longer than the reserve ends as length, stays invalid and is not resent.
